tab.lists.note: The domains/IPs themselves are edited in the “Routing lists” section below (by dragging). Here — only period/resolver settings for these lists.
tab.media.label: Media (IPTV)
tab.media.note: Media class (IPTV/video): upon seeing a large asymmetric flow, the agent pins the nearest prefix into the VPN — subsequent flows go through the VPN from the first packet (no FASTNAT sticking). Disabled by default.
tab.profiles.label: Profiles
tab.profiles.note: Profiles: a separate domain/IP list per tunnel, with its own mark and table. A profile is enabled once a name is set; it can also be set via the file /opt/susanin/etc/profiles.d/<name>.conf. Applied after Reload/Restart (sh /opt/susanin/tools/profiles.sh up), lists — profiles.sh refresh.
